title: Introduce 'Zen Evacuation Gate' and softfall reconciliation for regional failovers
author: Maya Patel
description:
Motivation: recent regional failovers were producing noisy simultaneous evacuations that amplified KV cache pressure and caused transient SLO violations for best-effort tenants. This PR introduces the 'Zen Evacuation Gate' — a lightweight coordination layer that tempers per-region evacuation decisions with a heartbeat-buffered admission window and a deferred-egress gate. The goal is to preserve hard SLOs while allowing safe, gradual tenant evacuation during overloads or capacity maintenance.

What this PR does (high level):
- Adds a region-level 'Zen Evacuation Gate' that gates eviction/evacuation commands based on a reconciled local health signal, a heartbeat buffer, and a probabilistic admission factor (configurable).
- Integrates the gate with the SLO manager so evacs will be rejected or delayed when the SLO budget delta is below threshold (configurable policy).
- Introduces a softfall reconciliation epoch: when an evacuation is delayed, a background reconciler attempts incremental KV-preserve handoffs to standby nodes to avoid sudden cold drains.
- Implements a deferred-egress gate to rate-limit egress (outbound routing to other regions) during coordinated failovers to prevent global cascading.
- Adds telemetry hooks: per-region gate state (open/closed/softbackoff), reconciliation progress metrics, and a 'zen.evacuations' histogram for latency-to-accept metrics.
- Adds an ops runbook and a feature flag for staged rollout (canary region => 50% => global).

Checklist: [x] unit tests added, [x] integration tests for staged eviction path, [x] runbook and rollout plan, [x] telemetry dashboards, [x] feature flag gating.

Testing and validation:
- Local unit tests cover admission logic and reconcilers.
- Integration test simulates a 3-region topology with one region entering degraded state; asserted that evacuations are staged and KV-preserve handoffs succeed in >95% synthetic runs.
- Ran a short canary in us-west-2 for 4 hours; observed SLO spend smoothing and no spike in global egress.

Rollout plan: staged feature-flagged rollout starting in canary region (us-west-2) for 24h, then 50% regional activation for 6h, then global activation if metrics are stable. If anomalies appear, flip feature flag to off for the region (immediate) and follow rollback steps below.

Rollback: feature flag off restores previous evacuation behavior instantly. Critical fallback: if reconciliation stalls and backlog grows > 5k inflight keys for > 10m, the control plane will force a graceful hard-evacuation (configurable override) and alert SRE.

Related: ENG-7842 (regional-failover-smoothing), ENG-7905 (kv-preserve-handoffs).
